metadata.question: Is the size of ozone hole (<220 Dobson units) over Antarctica between September 26 and 30, 2024 larger than that between August 26 and 30, 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: NASA OMI / OMPS ozone data (e.g., “NASA/OMI/ozone_v3” or “NASA/OMPS/ozone_v3”). - Date: - Late‐August window: 2024-08-26 to 2024-08-30 - Late‐September window: 2024-09-26 to 2024-09-30 - Location: Antarctica (use a polygon approximately −90 to −60 °S, full longitude span). 2. Masking / processing: - QA mask is not strictly required for column ozone; simply select the “ozone” band (in Dobson Units). - For each window composite a single mean image to suppress daily gaps. - Apply threshold < 220 DU to identify the “ozone-hole” pixels. - Sum the area of all pixels below 220 DU inside Antarctica polygon (scale ≈ 25 km native, use 25000 m in reduceRegion). - Compare the two summed areas (km²). 3. Logic for outputs: - If collection size==0 for either window → C1 (no images found). - If reduceRegion returns 0 from the count reducer → C2 (all nodata). - If result is None/NaN → C3. - Otherwise choose: A: September hole area > August hole area B: September hole area ≤ August hole area ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1) Geometry: roughly Antarctica (-90 to -60° S) ant = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-180, -90, 180, -60], None, False) date_aug = ['2024-08-26', '2024-08-30'] date_sep = ['2024-09-26', '2024-09-30'] def hole_area(start, end): col = (ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OMI/ozone_v3') .filterDate(start, end) .select('ozone')) n = col.size().getInfo() if n == 0: return None comp = col.mean().clip(ant) hole = comp.lt(220) # boolean, 1 where <220 DU # count of 25-km pixels and convert to km² pix_area = (ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(1e6) # km² .updateMask(hole)) area = pix_area.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=ant, scale=25000, maxPixels=1e9).get('area').getInfo() count = hole.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=ant, scale=25000, maxPixels=1e9).get('ozone').getInfo() return area, count aug = hole_area(*date_aug) sep = hole_area(*date_sep) if aug is None or sep is None: print("Empty collection for one window.") print("C1") else: a_aug, c_aug = aug a_sep, c_sep = sep print(f"Aug hole: {a_aug:.0f} km² Pixels: {c_aug}") print(f"Sep hole: {a_sep:.0f} km² Pixels: {c_sep}") if a_aug is None or a_sep is None: print("C3") elif c_aug == 0 and c_sep == 0: print("C2") else: print("A" if a_sep > a_aug else "B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1) Geometry: roughly Antarctica (-90 to -60° S)
ant = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-180, -90, 180, -60], None, False)

date_aug = ['2024-08-26', '2024-08-30']
date_sep = ['2024-09-26', '2024-09-30']

def hole_area(start, end):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OMI/ozone_v3')
             .filterDate(start, end)
             .select('ozone'))
    n = col.size().getInfo()
    if n == 0:
        return None
    comp = col.mean().clip(ant)
    hole = comp.lt(220)           # boolean, 1 where <220 DU
    # count of 25-km pixels and convert to km²
    pix_area = (ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(1e6)   # km²
                  .updateMask(hole))
    area = pix_area.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=ant,
        scale=25000,
        maxPixels=1e9).get('area').getInfo()
    count = hole.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=ant,
        scale=25000,
        maxPixels=1e9).get('ozone').getInfo()
    return area, count

aug = hole_area(*date_aug)
sep = hole_area(*date_sep)

if aug is None or sep is None:
    print("Empty collection for one window.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    a_aug, c_aug = aug
    a_sep, c_sep = sep
    print(f"Aug hole: {a_aug:.0f} km²  Pixels: {c_aug}")
    print(f"Sep hole: {a_sep:.0f} km²  Pixels: {c_sep}")
    if a_aug is None or a_sep is None:
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif c_aug == 0 and c_sep == 0:
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>A</answer>" if a_sep > a_aug else "<answer>B</answer>")
